opinions.text:
Per Curiam.
The appeal is dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Swift & Co. v. Wickham, 382 U. S. 111; Pennsylvania Public Utility Commission v. Pennsylvania Railroad Co., 382 U. S. 281.
opinions.author: Per Curiam.
